title: bridge_cert DER round-trip on every cert in every chain validation
description: validate_chain() DER-encodes and re-parses every certificate in the chain plus every trust anchor on each call via bridge_cert(). For a chain of 3 certs and 5 trust anchors this is 8 heap allocations and 8 DER parse/encode operations per verify() call. At scale (mail server verifying thousands of messages/second) with a large trust store this is measurable. The bridge is architecturally required while x509-cert 0.2 and 0.3-rc coexist, but the cost should be noted for when the version gap is resolved.
close_reason: Unavoidable: cms requires x509-cert 0.3.0-rc; pkix-chain requires x509-cert 0.2. The DER round-trip is the only lossless bridge until one dep upgrades. Track upstream.
